Hi Kelly —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We're pulling together the final MSA + Order Form redlines for OpticWare so legal can sign off and we can schedule billing. Two quick items I want to confirm before we submit the draft:

1) Announcement embargo: you mentioned an internal launch window at the end of July. Can you confirm the public announcement embargo date you want in the Order Form? We typically capture a hard embargo date and a separate clause for shortened notice if both parties agree.

2) Logo & reference rights: our standard Order Form includes a broad reference clause (permission to use logos, case study, press release). I know some customers prefer limited reference rights or a review period for marketing collateral. Can you confirm whether OpticWare wants:
  - logo usage only (no quote/case study)
  - logo + quote with 10 business day review, or
  - logo + case study + testimonial with approval rights

If you prefer, attach your brand guidelines and we can align the usage terms to that. For timing, our goal is to get redlines back to you by EOD Thursday (6/17) so we can route to legal.

Thanks, and cc'd Samir so legal has visibility.

— Karthik

Karthik / Laura —

Thanks for the context and the brand guide. Drafting notes below and attached a tracked-redline we can send to OpticWare: redline_msa_opticware.docx (see Section 6.3 and Order Form, Exhibit B). High-level suggestions:

1) Embargo language (Order Form):
  - "Customer shall not make any public announcement, press release, or other public disclosure regarding the existence of this Agreement, the parties' relationship, or Customer's use of the Services prior to 2027-07-30 (the 'Embargo End Date') without Customer's prior written consent. Either party may waive the Embargo End Date by mutual written agreement, provided that if Customer requests early release the Customer must provide at least seven (7) business days' prior written notice and Redwood shall have the right to review and approve the announcement content solely for accuracy (not for content or marketing message)."

2) Publicity / reference rights (MSA / Order Form):
  - Narrow the standard publicity clause to allow: (i) Customer logo on Redwood's partner page and in Redwood sales collateral (web, PDF, PPT); and (ii) Customer logo usage subject to Customer's brand guidelines (attached).
  - Add explicit exclusion: "Customer's logo shall not be used in press releases, public case studies, or third-party joint press announcements without Customer's separate written consent."
  - Quote/testimonial flow: "Redwood may request use of Customer quotes or testimonials; Customer shall have ten (10) business days from Redwood's delivery of proposed text to approve or decline in writing. Absence of response shall not be deemed approval."

3) Practical fallback: if OpticWare wants limited press participation for a co-announcement tied to product launch, we can offer a one-time exception: include a separate "Co-Launch Addendum" with pre-approved quote language and a single sign-off for that event.

I've kept the language precise to reduce negotiation cycles. If you want I can convert the redline into a shorter 'summary of changes' to include with the revised Order Form when we send to OpticWare.

Attaching: redline_msa_opticware.docx (tracked changes).
